name: HOTPVerify
description: Verifies an HOTP code against a secret and counter (RFC 4226). Optional window for counter desync tolerance.
syntax: HOTPVerify( string secret, string code, numeric counter, [struct options] )

params.name: options
params.description: Optional struct: window (default 0 — exact match), digits (default 6), algorithm (SHA1|SHA256|SHA512, default SHA1)
